content.user_title: Coordinate Agents With a Shared Activity Board
content.value_statement: Agents in separate sessions can miss changes and act on outdated information. This skill defines a shared activity board and verification routine to keep work aligned.
actual_capabilities: Defines a shared plain-text board, using LIVE.md at the workspace root by default.
Prescribes reading recent updates before reviewing, deploying, reporting, or changing shared resources.
Defines timestamped entries with agent identity, affected area, change details, and verification guidance.
Directs agents to verify live state when board entries conflict with reality.
Requires concise updates after relevant changes and archiving entries older than 14 days.
Sets ownership boundaries and directs concerns to the responsible agent or coordinator.
limitations: Provides procedural instructions, not a synchronization service or executable implementation.
Requires agents to access the same file and consistently follow the workflow.
Does not define file locking, conflict resolution, or automatic notifications.
Does not guarantee board accuracy; agents must verify current state.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Deployment Reviews
use_cases.description: Check recent deployment entries and verify the live version before reviewing an application.

use_cases.title: Share Integration Changes
use_cases.description: Record setting, domain, or webhook changes so other agents can use current configuration without exposing secrets.

use_cases.title: Maintain Session Continuity
use_cases.description: Read recent decisions and user priorities before starting work in a separate conversation.

prompt_templates.title: Read Recent Updates
prompt_templates.prompt: Read LIVE.md and summarize updates from the last 48 hours relevant to [area]. Do not modify anything.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: start a task with current context.

prompt_templates.title: Record a Completed Change
prompt_templates.prompt: Record [completed change] in LIVE.md with the current time, time zone, agent, area, and verification method. Exclude secrets and personal data.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: inform other agents after a change.

prompt_templates.title: Reconcile a Version Mismatch
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare the board entry for [application] with its live version using [approved check]. Correct stale information and report discrepancies without changing the application.

prompt_templates.title: Maintain the Shared Board
prompt_templates.prompt: Review LIVE.md for [area], verify relevant discrepancies through approved checks, and archive entries older than 14 days. Escalate other owners' issues without changing their resources.

output_examples.input: The board lists version 1.2.11, but an approved live check returns version 1.2.12. Prepare a review update.
output: The board entry was corrected to version 1.2.12.
The review will use the verified live version.

output_examples.input: An authorized webhook change is complete. Draft a board entry without exposing credentials.
output_examples.output: 2026-11-11 10:00 PST | Integration agent | Notifications | Webhook destination updated | Platform readback confirms the new destination is active.

best_practices: Agree on one shared board path and read recent entries before acting.
Write short, verifiable updates immediately after relevant changes, without secrets or personal data.
Verify discrepancies against live state and respect each agent's ownership boundaries.
anti_patterns: Reviewing a remembered version without checking recent board entries.
Recording credentials, personal data, or long narratives in the shared board.
Changing another agent's resources solely because an entry looks incorrect.

faq.question: Where is the board stored?
faq.answer: The default is LIVE.md at the shared workspace root. Agents can agree on another fixed path.

faq.question: When should an agent read the board?
faq.answer: Read it at task start and again before reviewing, deploying, reporting, or changing anything shared.

faq.question: What belongs in a board entry?
faq.answer: Include the timestamp, time zone, agent or chat, affected area, change summary, and verification method. Put the newest entry first.

faq.question: What happens when the board conflicts with reality?
faq.answer: Use a live check to establish the current state, then correct the board.

faq.question: Does this skill automatically synchronize agents?
faq.answer: No. It defines a shared-file workflow that agents must follow. It provides no synchronization service or automatic notifications.

faq.question: How should older entries and sensitive information be handled?
faq.answer: Archive entries older than 14 days. Never record keys, tokens, passwords, or personal data.
